title: 水分扣重与双实验室化验争议：报价、暂付款及放货决策
english: Moisture deduction and competing assay results

modules.title: 发音热身
modules.hint: 8分钟：先用0.72倍速跟读，再用1.0倍速复述；注意 moisture、representative、assay 的重音。
lines: Moisture adjustment
水分调整
Representative sampling
代表性取样
Assay discrepancy
化验结果差异
Dry metric ton
干吨
Independent laboratory
独立实验室
Provisional invoice
暂定发票
Settlement basis
结算依据
Commercial resolution
商业解决方案

modules.title: 10个高频词与短语
modules.hint: 8分钟：每个表达说出中文后，再独立造一个英文句子。
lines: Moisture deduction
水分扣减
Wet weight
湿重
Dry weight
干重
Split sample
分样
Sealed reference sample
封存的留样
Assay tolerance
化验允许偏差
Final settlement
最终结算
Price adjustment
价格调整
Disputed lot
存在争议的批次
Without prejudice
在不损害各方权利的前提下

modules.title: 10个核心句
modules.hint: 8分钟：先看中文复述英文，再模拟经理给出不含糊的指令。
lines: The gross weight is not the same as the payable dry weight.
毛重并不等于应结算的干重。
We must agree on the moisture deduction before pricing the lot.
在给这一批货定价前，我们必须先确认水分扣减。
Please show me the signed sampling record.
请把签字确认的取样记录给我。
The supplier's assay differs from our laboratory result.
供应商的化验结果与我们实验室的结果不同。
Do not blend the disputed lot with other material.
不要把争议批次与其他矿石混合。
We should retest the sealed reference sample.
我们应复检封存留样。
The contract specifies which result controls final settlement.
合同规定哪一份结果用于最终结算。
We can discuss a provisional payment without accepting the disputed grade.
我们可以讨论暂付款，但不代表接受有争议的品位。
Please put the proposed adjustment in writing.
请将建议的调整方案书面提交。
No one is authorized to release the goods until the dispute is documented.
在争议完成记录前，任何人均无权放货。

modules.title: 数字、品位、汇率和金额口述
modules.hint: 8分钟：朗读数据并从湿吨换算干吨；以下数据全是教学假设。
lines: The wet weight is 12.50 metric tons.
湿重为12.50公吨。
The measured moisture content is 6.0 percent.
实测水分为百分之六。
The dry weight is 11.75 metric tons.
干重为11.75公吨。
The supplier reports an assay of 31.2 percent.
供应商报告的化验品位为百分之三十一点二。
Our laboratory reports 29.8 percent.
我方实验室报告的品位为百分之二十九点八。
The assay difference is 1.4 percentage points.
两份化验结果相差1.4个百分点。
The provisional unit price is 200 US dollars per dry metric ton.
暂定单价为每干吨200美元。
The provisional amount is 2,350 US dollars.
暂定金额为2350美元。
The illustrative exchange rate is 1,450 Rwandan francs per US dollar.
假设汇率是每美元1450卢旺达法郎。
All amounts remain subject to the signed settlement formula.
所有金额均以双方签署的结算公式为准。

modules.title: 跟读训练
modules.hint: 7分钟：每句用正常速度跟读三遍，第二遍不看中文；重读关键动作词。
lines: Before we negotiate the price, let us verify the net weight.
价格谈判之前，我们先核实净重。
The moisture deduction must follow the agreed method.
水分扣减必须按照约定的方法进行。
I am not questioning your integrity; I am questioning the data.
我不是质疑你的诚信，而是在质疑数据。
We need a sample that genuinely represents the entire lot.
我们需要能够真实代表整批货的样品。
The sealing record should identify every party present.
封样记录应列明所有在场方。
Please separate factual differences from commercial concessions.
请把事实上的差异与商业让步分开。
An interim payment does not confirm the final assay.
临时付款不代表确认最终化验结果。
If the independent retest confirms the difference, we will apply the contract.
如果独立复检确认差异，我们将按合同执行。

modules.title: 商务破冰
modules.hint: 4分钟：以礼貌、不让步的方式开场。
lines: Thank you for coming to the warehouse on short notice.
感谢你临时赶到仓库。
How was the road from your site this morning?
今天早上从你们现场过来，路况怎么样？
I appreciate your team's effort to prepare the documents.
感谢你们团队准备文件所付出的努力。
We both want a fair and repeatable settlement process.
我们双方都希望建立公平且可重复执行的结算流程。
Let us start with the documents rather than assumptions.
我们先从文件入手，而不是凭猜测。
Once the facts are clear, the commercial discussion will be easier.
一旦事实明确，商业协商就会更容易。

modules.title: 矿石采购与化验争议
modules.hint: 10分钟：压力点一：供应商坚持自己的品位；压力点二：两次取样来源不一致。先问证据，再谈价格。
lines: Which sampling method was used at the loading point?
装货点采用了哪种取样方法？
Were the increments taken across the whole lot?
增量样是否覆盖了整个批次？
Who witnessed the sample preparation and splitting?
谁见证了制样和分样过程？
Our intake sample and your dispatch sample may not be comparable.
我们的入库样和你们的发运样可能不具有可比性。
Please provide the sample IDs, seal numbers and collection times.
请提供样品编号、封签号及采样时间。
We will quarantine the lot until the reference sample is checked.
在核验留样之前，我们会隔离这一批货。
We cannot revise the assay simply to close the deal.
我们不能仅仅为了成交而修改化验结果。
Let us appoint a mutually acceptable independent laboratory.
我们共同指定一家双方认可的独立实验室。
The retest cost should follow the dispute clause in the contract.
复检费用应按照合同的争议条款承担。
We can resume normal purchasing once the root cause is documented.
根本原因形成书面记录后，我们可以恢复正常采购。

modules.title: 仓库、物流与出口单证
modules.hint: 7分钟：将质量争议隔离与押运、出口文件、授权放货结合训练。
lines: Mark the lot as on hold in the warehouse register.
在仓库登记簿中将这一批标记为暂停处理。
Do not remove or replace any seal without written approval.
未经书面批准不得拆除或更换任何封签。
The stock card must match the physical bags and net weight.
库存卡片必须与实物吨包和净重一致。
The escort officer should sign the handover record.
押运人员应签署交接记录。
Keep the packing list consistent with the final confirmed weights.
装箱单应与最终确认重量保持一致。
Do not submit a disputed assay as the final export grade.
不要把有争议的化验结果作为最终出口品位提交。
Check the chain-of-custody documents before shipment authorization.
发运授权之前检查完整的货物流转与溯源文件。
If the paperwork is incomplete, escalate the shipment decision.
文件不完整时，应把是否发运的决定上报。

modules.title: 15分钟高压角色扮演
modules.hint: 15分钟：A为采购主管，B为供应商。三轮各5分钟；每轮先自己回答，再听示范。三项压力：化验差异、要求当天付款、要求先放货。
lines: Supplier: Your lab says 29.8 percent, but mine says 31.2 percent. Pay me on my result.
供应商：你们说29.8%，我这边是31.2%。按我的结果付钱。
Manager: I acknowledge the difference, but we must follow the signed sampling and assay procedure.
经理：我承认存在差异，但我们必须执行已签署的取样和化验程序。
Supplier: You took a different sample. Your number is unreliable.
供应商：你们取的是另一个样，结果不可靠。
Manager: Then let us compare sample IDs and retest the sealed reference sample together.
经理：那我们就核对样品编号，并共同复检封存留样。
Supplier: I need full payment today or I will sell to someone else.
供应商：我今天必须收到全款，否则卖给别人。
Manager: We can consider a documented provisional payment, but it will not settle the disputed grade.
经理：我们可以考虑有书面依据的暂付款，但这并不意味着品位争议已解决。
Supplier: At least release the bags so my truck can leave.
供应商：至少先放货，让我的卡车走。
Manager: The disputed bags must remain segregated until release is authorized in writing.
经理：争议吨包必须继续单独存放，直到获得书面放货授权。
Supplier: Your process is taking too long.
供应商：你们流程太慢了。
Manager: I will give you a clear written timeline and the exact next decision point.
经理：我会给你明确的书面时间安排和下一个决策节点。
Supplier: Who will pay for the independent test?
供应商：独立复检费谁承担？
Manager: We will apply the cost-allocation clause already agreed in the contract.
经理：我们会按照合同中已经约定的费用分担条款执行。
Supplier: Can you at least increase the price to compensate me?
供应商：那你们至少加点价补偿我吧？
Manager: We can discuss commercial terms separately after the facts are established.
经理：等事实查明后，我们可以另行讨论商业条款。
Supplier: I want a manager to approve this immediately.
供应商：我要经理立刻批准。
Manager: I am escalating the decision with the documents, not bypassing our controls.
经理：我会连同文件上报审批，而不是绕过内控程序。
Manager: Please confirm the agreed next steps in an email today.
经理：请今天通过电子邮件确认双方商定的下一步。
Supplier: Agreed. We will attend the joint retest tomorrow morning.
供应商：同意，我们明天早上参加联合复检。

modules.title: 五句听写
modules.hint: 4分钟：先点读不看文字，写完后再展开核对；网页会对本模块提供隐藏原文功能。
lines: The final price depends on the agreed moisture and assay adjustments.
最终价格取决于约定的水分和化验调整。
We have isolated the disputed batch in the warehouse.
我们已在仓库隔离争议批次。
Please provide the signed sampling and sealing records.
请提供签署过的取样和封样记录。
A provisional payment is not a final settlement.
暂付款并不等于最终结算。
We cannot release the goods without written authorization.
没有书面授权我们不能放货。

modules.title: 五道口语问答
modules.hint: 5分钟：每题限时45秒作答，再与示范句比较。
lines: Question: What should you check before accepting a supplier's assay? Answer: I check the sampling method, sample ID and contractual settlement basis.
问：接受供应商化验前应核对什么？答：取样方法、样品编号和合同结算依据。
Question: How do you handle a moisture discrepancy? Answer: I confirm wet weight, test method and the agreed dry-weight formula.
问：水分差异如何处理？答：确认湿重、检验方法和约定干重公式。
Question: Can you make a provisional payment? Answer: Only with written approval and a clear reservation of the final settlement.
问：能暂付款吗？答：只能在书面批准且明确保留最终结算条件时。
Question: Should you release disputed material for shipment? Answer: Not before quality and release authorization are documented.
问：争议矿石能先发运吗？答：质量和放货授权未形成文件前不能。
Question: What is your next step if the two labs disagree? Answer: I arrange a joint review and independent retest under the contract.
问：两家实验室不一致怎么办？答：依合同安排共同复核和独立复检。

modules.title: 近期知识复习
modules.hint: 4分钟：回顾Day26封签及付款控制，并把今日水分/化验争议接入同一决策链。
lines: A seal discrepancy requires immediate documentation.
封签差异必须立即形成记录。
A payment deadline does not justify bypassing verification.
付款截止时间不能成为绕过核验的理由。
An assay discrepancy requires sample traceability.
化验差异需要追溯样品来源。
The decision to release material needs a clear authority level.
放货决定必须有明确的授权层级。
Keep quality disputes separate from pricing concessions.
质量争议与价格让步应分开处理。
Our objective is a controlled transaction, not merely a fast transaction.
我们追求的是受控交易，而不仅是快速交易。

modules.title: 完整工作陈述
modules.hint: 6分钟：不看中文连续陈述90秒，再用英文复述并录音自评。
lines: Today we received a mineral lot with a disputed assay result.
今天我们收到一批化验结果存在争议的矿石。
The supplier reported 31.2 percent, while our laboratory reported 29.8 percent.
供应商报告31.2%，而我们实验室报告29.8%。
We also need to confirm the measured moisture content and dry weight.
我们还需要确认实测水分和干重。
I instructed the warehouse to segregate the disputed material.
我要求仓库隔离争议物料。
We are reviewing the sampling records, seal IDs and laboratory methods.
我们正在核对取样记录、封签号及实验室方法。
A jointly witnessed retest will provide additional evidence.
双方见证的复检将提供进一步证据。
Any provisional payment requires written approval and proper documentation.
任何暂付款都需要书面批准及完整文件。
We will not confuse a commercial concession with an accepted assay result.
我们不会把商业让步混同于对化验结果的认可。
Shipment authorization will follow the confirmed quality documents.
发运授权须以确认后的质量文件为依据。
Our aim is a fair settlement, reliable traceability and controlled risk.
我们的目标是公平结算、可靠追溯和风险可控。

modules.title: 完成清单
modules.hint: 3分钟：逐项英文自查。如果说不流利，返回对应模块再练。
lines: I can explain the difference between wet weight and dry weight.
我能解释湿重与干重的区别。
I can describe an assay discrepancy without accusing the supplier.
我能不带指责地描述化验差异。
I can ask for sampling, sealing and laboratory records.
我能索取取样、封样和化验记录。
I can propose an independent retest under the contract.
我能按照合同建议独立复检。
I can reject unauthorized shipment politely and firmly.
我能礼貌而坚定地拒绝未经授权的发运。
I can explain why a provisional payment is not final settlement.
我能解释暂付款不等于最终结算。
I can deliver the complete management briefing in English.
我能用英语完成整段管理层简报。
